G197/Asangaon-Kasara 4th Line/Shahapur Tq/7A] भवनेि कमार ग प् ता , म ख्य प्र िासजनक अजधकारी (जनमावण) MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS (Central Railway) NOTIFICATION Mumbai, the 18th February, 2026 Under clause 7A of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 S.O. 962(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (7A) of Section 2 of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989), (hereinafter referred to the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 (No.11 of 2008), the Central Government hereby authorize the officer mentioned in column (2) of the table below as “Competent Authority” to perform the functions as such authority under the said Act with effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette in respect of the special railway project of “Asangaon – Kasara 4th line Railway Project (34.97 Kms)” in the State of Maharashtra relating to Taluka Mentioned in Column (3) of the said table for the public purpose of execution maintenance, Management and operation of such special Railway Project. TABLE S. No. Competent Authority Taluka District 1 Dy. Collector (Land acquisition) Metro Centor-3 Thane Shahapur Thane [F. No. G197/Asangaon-Kasara 4th Line/Shahapur Tq/7A] BHUVNESH KUMAR GUPTA, Chief Administrative Officer (Construction) Uploaded by Dte. of Printing at Government of India Press, Ring Road, Mayapuri, New Delhi-110064 and Published by the Controller of Publications, Delhi-110054. -- 2 of 2 --
